I am 76 years old and have farmed this land in Kigoma since I was a girl. My plot is small, only what my family needs, and I grow our traditional crops mixed together. I do not have money for chemical fertilizer or bought seed, so I use my own saved seed and work the soil with my children. The rains will come soon enough, and we will manage the work ourselves as we always have.
